task_pattern: Paid order remains pending after payment webhook
description: Diagnose orders stuck in PENDING after successful payment webhooks by checking logs for payment.captured and updating the webhook handler event mapping.
solution_steps: Start from the incident logs and identify the exact webhook event type associated with the stuck order.
Compare the logged event type with the event names handled by src/handlers/paymentWebhook.js.
If logs show payment.captured but the handler only accepts payment.succeeded, map payment.captured to the paid-order transition.
Update the order store through the existing markPaid or status transition helper instead of mutating test data directly.
Keep duplicate webhook handling idempotent so replayed payment.captured events do not append duplicate status history.
Run the webhook tests for successful, duplicate, and unrelated events.
pitfalls: Do not trust the task wording alone; the decisive clue is the event name in logs/payment-webhook.log.
Payment providers may rename or version events; payment.succeeded and payment.captured are not interchangeable unless explicitly mapped.
Fixing only the test fixture or initial order status hides the incident instead of fixing the webhook path.
Duplicate webhook delivery is normal in production and should not create duplicate PAID history entries.
